title: Ombudsman finds former Bohol exec guilty of ‘serious dishonesty’

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman has found former Bohol provincial board member Vierna Mae Boniel-Maglasang guilty of “serious dishonesty,” thereby imposing a penalty of dismissal from service.
